newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to cling on to props around 102.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to cling on to props around 102.00.

text.p: A number of key support levels at or below the 102.00 area will hold the falling September Bund future in check on Tuesday, technical analysts said.
"We had quite an obvious reversal day yesterday, coming down to close near the important 102.53 level," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
"A downward move of the same width as the previous 65 tick range gets us down to just below 102.00."
September Bunds on LIFFE made a contract high of 103.15 on July 9 and hit session lows of 102.53 on July 10.
The contract was down 0.23 at 102.44 at 0700 GMT.
The 102.00 level is at the centre of the old 101.95-102.05 resistance area for the contract's upward move in May and June, Wood said.
Initial support for the contract lies at 102.30, Wood said. Daily charts show September Bunds hit a low of 102.30 on July 4. The contract reached a session low of 102.33 earlier on Tuesday.
Below there, 102.15 beckons ahead of the 102.00 support, Wood said.
"We will get to there and then consolidate, unless the T-bonds start to break down."
Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International, told Reuters Financial Television the contract could bounce back from support.
"Selling pressure is not really strong. It can come down to 102.10 and simply rebound from there."
Resistance for the contract is solid between 102.52 and 102.58, Wood said.
"But we have to get back above 102.75 to turn it back around to the upside."
December Euromarks were down 0.02 at 96.62 at 0717 GMT. Penetration of 96.62 will lead to falls to 96.54, analysts said.
